away.summary: The Blues (6-6-1) are expected to dress the same lineup from their 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Thursday. Forward Otto Stenberg was reassigned to Springfield of the AHL after that game. The team is dealing with several injuries on defense and forward depth.

out.detail: undisclosed injury, will miss at least three more games

home.summary: The Red Wings (6-4-3) return home after a four-game road trip to face the Blues on Hockeytown Halloween. Coach Todd McLellan said Kasper and Appleton are each 10-14 days away from a possible return, while Johansson will miss at least three more games. Bernard-Docker was recalled from Grand Rapids and Axel Sandin-Pellikka was reassigned there.
